40004296.author: पदार्थः
40004296.content: रमयताम् among those who bring delight to others, श्रेष्ठः best, सः रामः that Rama, तं वृक्षम् to that tree, समासाद्य having reached, पश्चिमाम् western, सन्ध्याम् sandhya, अन्वास्य having offered oblations, लक्ष्मणम् looking at Lakshmana, इति these words, उवाच ह spoke.

40004296.author: Translation
40004296.content: On reaching the foot of the tree, Rama offered oblations to Sandhya of the west. And then he who is the best in keeping people in good humour said to Lakshmana:

40004297.author: पदार्थः
40004297.content: अद्य today, सुमन्त्रेण Sumantra, रहिता without, या इयम् this, प्रथमा रात्रिः first night, जनपदात्   away from human habitation, बहिः outside, याता will be spent, ताम् about that night, उत्कण्ठितुम् to feel anxiety, नार्हसि does not behove.

40004297.author: Translation
40004297.content: We will have to spend this first night without Sumantra and away from human habitation. (Yet) you need not worry.

40004298.author: पदार्थः
40004298.content: लक्ष्मण O Lakshmana, अद्य प्रभृति from now on, रात्रिषु during the nights, अतन्द्रिभ्याम्  sleeplessly, जागर्तव्यम् keep awake, सीतायाः Sita's, योगक्षेमौ acquisition and protection, अवयोः on both of us, वर्ते हि depends.

40004298.author: Translation
40004298.content: O Lakshmana, from now on we must be sleeplessly vigilant at night. The welfare and safety of Sita depend on us both.

40004299.author: पदार्थः
40004299.content: सौमित्रे O Lakshmana, इमां रात्रिम् this night, कथञ्चिदेव somehow, वर्तयामहे pass, स्वयम् by ourselves, आर्जितैः procured, भूमौ on the ground, आस्तीर्य spread with, उपावर्तामहे we will lie down.

40004299.author: Translation
40004299.content: O Lakshmana, we will have to somehow pass this night, sleeping on the ground spread with whatever we have procured.

40004300.author: पदार्थः
40004300.content: महार्हशयनोचितः fit to rest on luxurious bed, सः Rama, मेदिन्याम् on the ground, संविश्य lying down, सौमित्रये to Lakshmana, शुभाः beneficial, इमाः कथाः these words, व्याजहार uttered.

40004300.author: Translation
40004300.content: Rama who deserved a luxurious bed lay down on the ground and uttered these beneficial words to Lakshamana:

40004301.author: पदार्थः
40004301.content: लक्ष्मण O Lakshmana, अद्य at this time, महाराजः the great king, ध्रुवम् surely, दुःखम् with difficulty, स्वपिति sleeps, कृतकामा with the desires fulfilled, कैकेयी तु however Kaikeyi, तुष्टा satisfed, भवितुम् अर्हति should become.

40004301.author: Translation
40004301.content: O Lakshmana, the maharaja must be having a painful sleep tonight. But Kaikeyi with her desires fulfilled, ought to feel satisfied.

40004302.author: पदार्थः
40004302.content: सा that, देवी queen, कैकेयी Kaikeyi, आगतम् arrived, भरतम् Bharata, दृष्ट्वा having seen, राज्यकारणात् for the sake of kingdom, महाराजम् king, प्राणान् life, न च्यावयेदपि will not deprive  of.

40004302.author: Translation
40004302.content: After the arrival of Bharata, I hope queen Kaikeyi does not deprive the king of his life for the sake of the kingdom?

40004303.author: पदार्थः
40004303.content: अनाथश्च forlorn, वृद्धश्च aged, मया by me, विना च कृतः separated, कामात्मा that lustful one, कैकेयीवशम् under the influence of Kaikeyi, आगतः having come, किं what, करिष्यति can he   do?

40004303.author: Translation
40004303.content: That lustful king, having come under the hold of Kaikeyi, has been deprived of my presence. What can that forlorn and aged king do?

40004304.author: पदार्थः
40004304.content: इदम् this, व्यसनम् calamity, राज्ञः king's, मतिविभ्रमं च mind's aberration, आलोक्य having seen, अर्थधर्माभ्याम् between wealth (artha) and righteousness (dharma), काम एव passion only, गरीयान् is stronger, इति thus, मे मतिः is my thinking.

40004304.author: Translation
40004304.content: Reflecting on the calamity and mental aberration of the king, I think passion is stronger than wealth and righteousness.

40004305.author: पदार्थः
40004305.content: लक्ष्मण O Lakshmana, तातः father, मामिव as in my case, प्रमदायाः कृते for the sake of a woman, छन्दानुवर्तिनम् obedient, पुत्रम् son, अविद्वानपि even an illiterate man, कः पुमान् who is the man, त्यजेत् will abandon?

40004305.author: Translation
40004305.content: O Lakshmana, will even an illiterate man for the sake of a woman ever abandon his son like me who is faithful and obedient, as did my father?

40004306.author: पदार्थः
40004306.content: यः he, एकः alone, अधिराजवत् like an emperor, मुदितान् with happy people, कोसलान् Kosala country, भोक्ष्यति will enjoy, सभार्यः with his spouse, कैकयी सुतः Kaikeyi's son, भरतः Bharata, सुखी  with happniess, बतः may be.

40004306.author: Translation
40004306.content: Bharata, son of Kaikeyi, with his wife will alone enjoy like an emperor this kingdom of Kosala full of happy people.

40004307.author: पदार्थः
40004307.content: ताते dear one, वयसा with age, अतीते advanced, मयि च I also, अरण्यम् the forest, आस्थिते dwelling, सः that Bharata, सर्वस्य entire, राज्यस्य kingdom, एकम् alone, मुखम् chief man, भविष्यति will remain.

40004307.author: Translation
40004307.content: The king is advanced in age and I have to dwell in the forest. Therefore, Bharata alone will be the chief of this entire kingdom.

40004308.author: पदार्थः
40004308.content: यः he, अर्थधर्मौ dharma and artha (prosperity and righteousness), परित्यज्य having abandoned, कामम् pleasure, अनुवर्तते seeks, राजा such a king, दशरथो यथा like Dasaratha, क्षिप्रम् soon, एवम् in this way, आपद्यते will reach such a state.

40004308.author: Translation
40004308.content: Any king who abandons dharma and artha and adopts a life of pleasure will very soon reach this state as Dasaratha has attained.

40004309.author: पदार्थः
40004309.content: सौम्य handsome, कैकेयी Kaikeyi, दशरथान्ताय for the destruction of Dasaratha, मम my,  प्रव्राजनाय च for banishment, भरतस्य Bharata's, राज्याय च for kingdom, सम्प्राप्ता arrived, मन्ये I consider.

40004309.author: Translation
40004309.content: O handsome Lakshmana I think Kaikeyi has come to our house for the destruction of Dasaratha, for my banishment and enthronement of Bharata in the kingdom.

40004310.author: पदार्थः
40004310.content: कैकेयी Kaikeyi, सौभाग्यमदमोहिता intoxicated with good fortune, मत्कृते because of me, कौसल्यां च Kausalya, सुमित्रां च and also Sumitra, इदानीम् now, अपि न संप्रबाधेत will not torment?

40004310.author: Translation
40004310.content: Intoxicated with her good fortune will not Kaikeyi torment Kausalya and Sumitra for my sake?

40004311.author: पदार्थः
40004311.content: लक्ष्मण Lakshmana, मत्कारणात् because of me, देवी mother, सुमित्रा Sumitra, दुःखम् in sorrow, मा आवसेत् स्म should not experience, त्वम् you, काल्ये in the morning, इत एव from here, अयोध्याम् to Ayodhya, प्रविश enter.

40004311.author: Translation
40004311.content: O Lakshmana, because of me mother Sumitra should not live in sorrow. Therefore, tomorrow morning go back to Ayodhya from here itself.

40004312.author: पदार्थः
40004312.content: अहम् myself I, एकः alone, सीतया सह along with Sita, दण्डकान् Dandaka forest, गमिष्यामि  shall go, अनाथायाः for the helpless, कौशल्यायाः for Kausalya, त्वम् you, नाथः (भविष्यसि) be a protector.

40004312.author: Translation
40004312.content: I shall go with Sita into the Dandaka forest and you be the protector of the helpless, Kausalya.

40004313.author: पदार्थः
40004313.content: क्षुद्रकर्मा one of heinous deeds, कैकेयी Kaikeyi, द्वेष्यम् in hostility, अन्याय्यम् unjust actions, आचरेत् follows, मम my, मातरम् mother, धर्मज्ञे with the righteous, भरते to Bharata, परिदद्याः हि you may entrust.

40004313.author: Translation
40004313.content: Kaikeyi who is a woman of heinous deeds may follow, out of hostility, an unjust way in respect of my mother. In that case my mother may be entrusted to the care of Bharata who is righteous.

40004314.author: पदार्थः
40004314.content: सौमित्रे Lakshmana, मम जनन्या by my mother, कस्मिन् जात्यन्तरे in some previous birth, स्त्रियः women, पुत्रैः with sons, वियोजिताः separated, तस्मात्  for that reason, एतत् all this, उपस्थितम् befallen, नूनम् certainly.

40004314.author: Translation
40004314.content: O Lakshmana, surely in one of her previous births did my mother separate women from their sons. That is why this (calamity) has befallen her.

40004315.author: पदार्थः
40004315.content: चिरपुष्टेन nurtured for a long time, दुःखसंवर्धितेन reared with great dificulty, मया me, कौशल्या Kausalya, फलकाले at the moment of fuition, विप्रायुज्यत has been separated, माम् me, धिक् अस्तु shame on me.

40004315.author: Translation
40004315.content: Kausalya nurtured me for a long time and reared me with great difficulty. When she was going to enjoy the fruits of her labour, I have been separated from her. Fie upon me

40004316.author: पदार्थः
40004316.content: सौमित्रे Lakshmana, यः अहम् am I, अम्बायाः to my mother, अनन्तकम् infinite, शोकम् pain, दद्मि am giving, ईदृशम् such, पुत्रम् a son, काचित् सीमन्तिनी (जननी) any mother, मा स्म जनयेत् may not give birth.

40004316.author: Translation
40004316.content: O Lakshmana, I am causing endless sorrow to my mother. May no mother give birth to a son like me

40004317.author: पदार्थः
40004317.content: लक्ष्मण O Lakshmana, यस्याः myna's, शुक parrot, अरेः enemy's, पादम् foot, दश bite, तत् वाक्यम् such statement, श्रूयते heard, सा शारिका that myna, मत्तः more than I, प्रीतिविशिष्टा more pleased, मन्ये I think.

40004317.author: Translation
40004317.content: (On hearing my banishment) her myna would say to her parrot, 'O parrot, bite the foot of the enemy (Kaikeyi)'. I think  that bird is  a greater source of joy to my mother than I, O Lakshmana

40004318.author: पदार्थः
40004318.content: अरिन्दम conquerer of enemies, शोचन्त्याः experiencing great sorrow, अल्पभाग्यायाः less fortunate, अपुत्रायाः without a son, किञ्चित् little, नोपकुर्वता could not be helped, पुत्रेण by the son, मया by me, किम् what, कार्यम् can be done?

40004318.author: Translation
40004318.content: My mother has less fortune and more grief like a woman without a son, O Lakshmana, subduer of enemies For her, what is the use of a son like me who cannot render any service to her?

40004319.author: पदार्थः
40004319.content: अल्पभाग्या less fortunate, मे माता my mother, कौशल्या Kausalya, मया with me, रहिता bereft of, परमदुःखार्ता extremely distressed, शोकसागरे ocean of sorrow, पतिता fallen into, शेते  must be lying.

40004319.author: Translation
40004319.content: My mother is unlucky as she has been separated from me. Extremely distressed, she must have plunged into an ocean of grief.

40004320.author: पदार्थः
40004320.content: लक्ष्मण Lakshmana, अहम् I, क्रुद्धः am enraged, एकः alone, अयोध्यां च Ayodhya, पृथिवीं चापि and also the whole earth, इषुभिः with arrows, तरेयम् will cross, वीर्यम् prowess, अकारणं ननु without reason.

40004320.author: Translation
40004320.content: Once enraged, O Lakshmana I can overpower Ayodhya, even the whole world all by myself with my arrows. But exhibition of prowess without any reason is not desirable.

40004321.author: पदार्थः
40004321.content: अनघ O sinless one, अहम् I, अधर्मभयभीतश्च with the fear of unrighteous conduct, परलोकस्य च for the other world also, लक्ष्मण Lakshmana, तेन therefore, अद्य at this time, आत्मानम् myself, नाभिषेचये did not get crowned.

40004321.author: Translation
40004321.content: O sinless one, I did not get myself coronated owing to fear of unrighteous conduct and fear of the other world.

40004322.author: पदार्थः
40004322.content: रामः Rama, निशि in the night, विजने in the desolate, वने in the  forest, एतत् all these, अन्यच्च and other, करुणम् pitiful, विलप्य lamenting, अश्रुपूर्णमुखः face filled with tears, तूष्णीम् silently, उपाविशत् sat.

40004322.author: Translation
40004322.content: Like this and in many other ways Rama lamented pitifully in that desolate forest. When his face was filled with tears, he sat silently in the night.

40004323.author: पदार्थः
40004323.content: विलप्य having lamented, उपरतम् ceased, गतार्चिषम् with extinguished flames, अनलम् इव  like fire, निर्वेगम् without moving, समुद्रमिव like the sea, रामम् Rama, लक्ष्मणः Lakshmana, आश्वासयत consoled.

40004323.author: Translation
40004323.content: Lakshmana consoled Rama who ceased to lament like fire with extinguished flames or like a motionless sea:

40004324.author: पदार्थः
40004324.content: आयुधिनाम् among wielder of weapons, वर foremost, राजन् O king, अद्य now, अयोध्यापुरी city of Ayodhya, त्वयि when you, निष्क्रान्ते had departed, गतचन्द्र without moon, शर्वरीव like night, निष्प्रभा without lustre, ध्रुवम् certain.

40004324.author: Translation
40004324.content: O Rama, foremost of warriors, it is certain that since your departure, the city of Ayodhya must be lustreless like night without the Moon.

40004325.author: पदार्थः
40004325.content: राम O Rama, इदम् in this manner, यत् परितप्यते that you are lamenting, एतत् all this, औपयिकम् proper, न not, पुरुषर्षभ foremost of men, सीतां च Sita, मां चैव me also, विषादयसि disheartening.

40004325.author: Translation
40004325.content: This is not the way you should lament, O Rama. O foremost of men, by doing so you are disheartening me and Sita as well.

40004326.author: पदार्थः
40004326.content: राघव O Rama, त्वया by you, हीना without, सीता Sita, न not,  अहमपि I also, न not, जलात्  from water, उद्धृतौ removed, मत्स्याविव like fish, मुहूर्तमपि even for a moment, न जीवावः will not survive.

40004326.author: Translation
40004326.content: Without you Sita or I will not survive even for a moment like a fish taken out of water, O Rama

40004327.author: पदार्थः
40004327.content: परन्तप O tomentor of enemies, Rama, अहम् I, अद्य now, त्वया विना without you, तातम्  father, द्रष्टुम् see, न हि इच्छेयम् shall not desire, शत्रुघ्नम् Satrughna, न not, सुमित्राम्  Sumitra, स्वर्गं चापि even heaven.

40004327.author: Translation
40004327.content: Without you, O Rama, tormentor of enemies, I wish to see neither father nor Satrughna nor Sumitra nor even heaven itself

40004328.author: पदार्थः
40004328.content: ततः thereafter, तत्र there, सुखासीनौ seated comfortably, धर्मवत्सलौ attached to righteousness, नातिदूरे not far (from there), न्यग्रोधे under a banyan tree, सुकृताम् wellmade,  तां शय्याम् that bed, निरीक्ष्य having seen, भेजाते lay down.

40004328.author: Translation
40004328.content: Thereafter Rama and Sita, the duo, nurturers of righteousness, from their comfortable  seats moved to the bed wellmade under the banyan tree not far (from there where they were sitting) and lay down (to sleep).

40004329.author: पदार्थः
40004329.content: परन्तपः tormentor of enemies, सः राघवः that Rama, एवम् thus, लक्ष्मणस्य Lakshmana's, उत्तमपुष्कलम् excellent and copious, वचः utterances, आदरात् out of love, निशम्य having heard, सुचिराय for a long period, धर्मम् that code of conduct of forest life, प्रपद्य having obtained, समस्ता: all, समाः the years, वनवासम् life in the forest, विदधे resorted to.

40004329.author: Translation
40004329.content: Rama, the tormentor of enemies, listened, out of love, to the excellent and copious words of Lakshmana and permitted him to live in the forest for the entire period of fourteen years by observing the prescribed code of conduct as enjoined on  life in the forest.

40004330.author: पदार्थः
40004330.content: ततः thereafter, तदा then, विजने in desolation, तस्मिन् that, वने in the  forest, महाबलौ very strong, तौ the two, राघववंशवर्धनौ perpetuators of the Raghu race, (Rama and Lakshmana), गिरिसानु गोचरौ dwelling on the slopes of mountains, सिंहौ यथैव  like two lions, भयम् fear, सम्भ्रमम् hesitation, न अभ्युपेयतुः did not feel.

40004330.author: Translation
40004330.content: Then the two mighty perpetuators of the Raghu race, who were like two lions dwelling on the slopes of mountains, lived in that lonely forest  without fear or hesitation. इत्यार्षे श्रीमद्रामायणे वाल्मीकीय आदिकाव्ये अयोध्याकाण्डे त्रिपञ्चाशस्सर्गः।। Thus ends the fiftythird sarga of Ayodhyakanda of the holy Ramayana, the first epic composed by sage Valmiki.
